verdict.rationale: Jira clearly has a REST API: there is an OpenAPI spec, a versioned v3 reference, and a formal REST API policy. But no evidence item documents API rate limits, quotas, or concurrency caps. The API policy covers deprecation and versioning only, which is an adjacent topic and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know the documented API rate limits and concurrency caps before building automation at scale
